payment_terms.value_text: The provided excerpts do not specify the time allowed for the employer to pay a bill.
payment_terms.notes: The excerpts mention 'On-Account' payments and deductions for security deposits under Clause 46, but do not state the payment period or number of days allowed for payment.

retention.value_text: Security deposit is recovered at the rate of 6% of the bill amount until the full Security Deposit of 5% of the contract value is recovered.
retention.quote: Balance of Security Deposit may be deposited by the Contractor in cash or Term Deposit Receipt issued from Scheduled commercial bank of India or irrevocable Bank Guarantee bond issued from Scheduled commercial bank of India, or may be recovered at the rate of 6% of the bill amount till the full Security Deposit is recovered.
retention.notes: The total Security Deposit is 5% of the contract value, and it is recovered at 6% from each running bill until the total reaches 5% of the contract value.

advance.value_text: Mobilisation advance is limited to 10% of the contract value and paid in two stages of 5% each, subject to interest.
advance.quote:
Mobilisation Advance –
This shall be limited to 10% of the Contract value and shall be paid in 2 stages :
Stage 1– 5% of Contract Value on signing of the contract agreement.
Stage 2 – 5% on mobilization of site-establishment, setting up offices, bringing in equipment
and actual commencement of work.
advance.notes: The advance bears interest, and if diverted for other purposes, interest is payable at 15% per annum. Recovery commences when the value of contract executed reaches 15% and is completed at 85%.

liquidated_damages.value_text: Liquidated damages for contractor's delay are charged at variable rates per week depending on the duration of the extension (between 0.01% to 0.05%, 0.10%, or 0.30% of the contract value), capped at a total of 5% of the contract value.
liquidated_damages.quote: As decided by Engineer, between 0.01% to 0.05% of contract value for each week or part of the week
liquidated_damages.notes: The rate varies depending on the duration of extension of time under Clause 17B: (i) Up to 25% of original period: 0.01% to 0.05% per week; (ii) Above 25% up to 50%: 0.10% per week; (iii) Above 50%: 0.30% per week. Total cap is 5%.

escalation.value_text: Price Variation Clause (PVC) is applicable for tenders having advertised value above Rs. 2 Crores and completion period above 12 months.
escalation.quote: 46A.1 Applicability: Price Variation Clause (PVC) shall be applicable only in tender having advertised value above Rs. 2 Crores and having completion period above 12 months.
escalation.notes: The clause sets conditions for applicability based on tender value and completion period.

performance_security.value_text: The successful bidder must submit a Performance Guarantee within 21 days from the date of issue of Letter of Acceptance, though the exact percentage is not specified in the excerpts.
performance_security.quote: The successful bidder shall have to submit a Performance Guarantee (PG) within 21 (Twenty one) days from the date of issue of Letter of Acceptance (LOA).
performance_security.notes: The excerpts mention the Performance Guarantee requirement, validity period, and submission timeline, but the numeric percentage of the contract price is not stated within the provided text. Excerpt page 56 mentions a total combined limit of 10% for retained amounts including Performance Guarantee for defaulting contractors.
